definitions.explanation: The horizontal measurement of something from side to side.
The extent or variety of something; room for variation.

examples.japanese: この{道|みち}は{幅|はば}が{狭|せま}い。
examples.english: This road is narrow (has little width).

examples.japanese: {幅|はば}{広|ひろ}い{知識|ちしき}を{持|も}っている。
examples.english: They have a wide range of knowledge.

notes:
USAGE: {幅|はば} refers to physical width and figurative breadth/range.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{幅|はば}が{広|ひろ}い／{狭|せま}い (wide/narrow)
・{幅|はば}を{広|ひろ}げる (to broaden)
・{幅|はば}{広|ひろ}く (broadly, widely)
・〜の{幅|はば} (the width of ~, the range of ~)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{幅|はば}{広|ひろ}い (wide, broad)
・{振|ふ}り{幅|はば} (range of movement, swing width)
・{値|ね}{幅|はば} (price range)
・{上|じょう}げ{幅|はば} (margin of increase/decrease)

DIMENSIONS:
・{幅|はば} - width
・{長|なが}さ - length
・{高|たか}さ - height
・{深|ふか}さ - depth
